content.short: OMOSwap is a cross-chain swap protocol using Circle's CCTP to enable native USDC transfers between blockchains without wrapped token intermediaries.
content.description: OMOSwap is a cross-chain decentralized exchange built on Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP), which enables native USDC to be burned on the source chain and minted on the destination chain  eliminating wrapped token counterparty risk entirely. By leveraging Circle's official infrastructure, OMOSwap provides the safest possible cross-chain stablecoin transfers for Mantle DeFi users. The protocol is deployed on Mantle and all other CCTP-supported chains.
content.meta: OMOSwap is a CCTP-based cross-chain swap for native USDC transfers to and from Mantle. Discover OMOSwap on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
